parameters.name: softDelete
parameters.description:
Legacy deletion flag. Set true to soft delete the document, equivalent to
deleteType=SOFT_DELETE. Existing requests remain supported.
Ignored when deleteType is supplied.

parameters.name: deleteType
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive deletion mode; surrounding whitespace is ignored.
Defaults to HARD_DELETE when no deletion option is supplied.
Takes precedence over the deprecated softDelete parameter when both are supplied.

schema.description:
Deletion mode for DELETE /documents/{documentId}.
SOFT_DELETE temporarily hides the document until restored.
HARD_DELETE deletes document metadata and current contents.
CONTENT_ONLY deletes the current S3 object while preserving document metadata and associated
records. Existing S3 versions are retained; this mode does not purge historical content.
schema.title: DocumentDeleteType
